?: the Qt '?' help button is the Help button
period[ns]: Qt caption: native field 'Period (ns)' (shown greyed until Periodic convolution is ticked, the Qt tool hid it)
tau0[ns]: Qt caption: native field 'tau0 (ns)' in the Distance grid panel (FRET mode)
r/r0range: Qt 'R/R0 range' three stacked boxes: native 'R/R0 min', 'R/R0 max' and 'R points' (FRET mode)
taugrid[ns]: Qt 'tau grid [ns]' three stacked boxes: native 'tau min (ns)', 'tau max (ns)', 'tau points'
l-curvespan[dec]: Qt 'L-curve span [dec]' two boxes: native 'decades below nu' / 'decades above nu' in the L-curve span and sampling section
fix: Qt per-field 'fix' boxes: native 'fix timeshift', 'fix background', 'fix IRF background', 'fix donor-only fraction'; the Qt 'fix' of lamp scatter is not read by the Qt tool and has no native counterpart
irf: Qt toolbar 'IRF' (choose an IRF dataset): native 'IRF file' (file) and, with a live session, 'Use as IRF' for a dataset
start@fracofpeak: Qt keeps this box permanently hidden; the setting stays at 0.9 and is still part of the JSON preferences
irfmodel.convolve.irf(default): Qt label 'IRF: model.convolve.irf (default)': native line 'IRF: <name>' with the real source
donorspectrumtau0only: Qt label 'Donor spectrum: tau0 only' (FRET mode): native 'Donor spectrum: required in FRET mode (Donor).' / '<n> components'
